tasks.title: Red Team stress-test of every BATCH-23ec69 proposal on six declared joints

handoff.objective: Independently stress-test every proposal filed by BATCH-23ec69 (the novel point-representation set under RQ-ECDLP-623a32 and the SAT/SMT relation-finding set under RQ-ECDLP-f0a7b0) as committed in the snapshot archive TASK-20260905-8443e4: mechanism distinctness from the nearest internal work, the lossy-projection audit, hidden assumptions, omitted end-to-end costs, the dominated_by and sota_delta honesty, the adequacy of the declared null and known-false controls, and the cheapest discriminating test for each.

constraints: Review only the Coordinator-committed snapshot named in the batch dispatch queue receipt for TASK-20260905-8443e4; confirm the commit exists and the reviewed paths match its recorded hashes before reading them as durable artifacts.
Independent session. Do not read any other reviewer's report. Attest the paths actually read.

For every filed proposal report holds, breaks or inconclusive on each of these joints, with the attack actually run and its result named. J1 mechanism distinctness, the nearest internal record read in full and the claimed precise difference tested. J2 the lossy-projection audit (representation set) or the pipeline-stage and target-kind statement (SAT set), tested for the change-of- coordinates failure or the enumerator-in-disguise failure respectively. Run the proves-too-much control where a record argues a stage change; choose objects the claim would find inconvenient and report where the argument survives.
Apply the obstruction reversal of agents/red-team.md item 8 to any record that closes a route, and file resource readings as findings, never as evidence.

Preserve the narrowest valid conclusion. A finding is a scoped objection with a named repair or a named cheapest test; never an impossibility claim, never a status change, never an edit to the reviewed records.
No experiments and no implementation; maximum_runs is 0. Symbolic checks and literature retrieval only.

Write one report only under the assigned write_scope, as YAML with a red_team_report root per agents/red-team.md, carrying per-proposal verdict blocks keyed by idea id and a closing review_attestation (joints owned, paths read, read_sibling_reports false, requested_policy review-adversarial, the inherited runtime provenance stated honestly, no probe invented).
completion_gate: The report exists, parses, covers every filed proposal id with a verdict on each of the six joints, names at least one cheapest discriminating test per proposal, and closes with a complete review_attestation.

review_plan.claim_under_review: Each BATCH-23ec69 proposal's own claim, as its producer stated it in the filed IDEA record: for the representation set (RQ-ECDLP-623a32), that the named point representation is a genuinely lossy, deterministically propagating object that makes a named non-generic operation cheaper at a stated attack stage; for the SAT/SMT set (RQ-ECDLP-f0a7b0), that the named constraint-technology use changes a stated pipeline stage by a stated exponent, amortised constant, or certifiability property. The exact claim text is read from each ledger/proposals record; the Coordinator does not restate it.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: Recorded before any report returns. Representation set: most candidates will fail the lossy-projection joint as reparametrisations (the PGL_2 null reproduces them) or as projections that do not propagate; at most one or two survive with a genuinely different stage cost, and that cost is a constant, not an exponent. SAT/SMT set: no candidate moves the search exponent below the SATIC ceiling of ml - log2|G| bits or its prime-field analogue; the certificate, model-counting and amortisation ideas survive as tooling and measurement with honest constants; the learned-clause-to-ideal-membership bridge is the candidate most likely to return a surprising result in either direction. If the review finds an exponent-moving survivor in either set, that overturns this prior and is the most informative outcome of the round.

joints.joint: J1 mechanism distinctness: the record's stated precise difference from its nearest internal record changes the tracked object or the pipeline stage, not only the notation.
joints.attack_plan: Read the nearest internal record named in each novelty_screen in full (mechanism, not title). Write the two tracked objects side by side and test whether a change of names maps one record onto the other; where the difference is a parameter choice (a specific d, model, encoding or solver), test whether the record derives a consequence the neighbour does not. Coordinator's expected break: representation records that are degree-d maps in disguise (IDEA-20260808-2e14f7) and SAT records that restate IDEA-20260904-3c7a91's ceiling.
joints.breaking_artifact: A one-paragraph renaming map from the record to its neighbour under which every claim of the record is already asserted by the neighbour.

joints.joint: J2 lossy projection or pipeline stage: a representation record discards information and the retained part propagates deterministically; a SAT record's search is not a complete enumerator with a leaf test.
joints.attack_plan: For each representation record, exhibit the fibre of the projection and the one-step propagation rule; if the pair {x, discarded data} is recoverable from the retained data the object is a change of coordinates (the KN-LIT-7595 (Delta, Pi) failure). For each SAT record, write the search as a tree over the declared variables and ask what conflict can occur above the leaf depth; if none, the record is an enumerator and any claimed exponent is the enumeration bound. Coordinator's expected break: at least half the representation records fail the second clause exactly as IDEA-20260807-4cebed did.
joints.breaking_artifact: Either an explicit recovery map showing nothing is discarded, or an explicit propagation failure (two preimages with different images), or a depth argument showing no above-leaf conflict exists.

joints.joint: J3 hidden assumptions and omitted end-to-end costs: the record's charged cost includes setup, transport, encoding, proof checking, memory, verification, relation yield, linear algebra and descent.
joints.attack_plan: Recompute each record's end-to-end path from its target_complexity block, adding every stage the record leaves implicit; compare the recomputed total with the record's stated exponents and with Pollard rho at N^(1/2). Coordinator's expected break: representation records that price the decomposition but not the membership test or the transport of the target into the representation; SAT records that price the solve but not encoding, proof checking or per-target amortisation setup.
joints.breaking_artifact: A recomputed cost table in which an omitted stage dominates the claimed saving.

joints.joint: J4 Pareto honesty: dominated_by was checked against every frontier row the record names and against Pollard rho, BSGS and the closest specialised baseline; sota_delta is quantitative or an explicitly unquantified boundary.
joints.attack_plan: List the frontier rows each record names, add the rows it omits (rho with distinguished points, BSGS, the honest enumeration bound of IDEA-20260904-96c4f3 for SAT records, PKM small-root decomposition for prime-field records), and check dominance on time, memory and data/queries separately. An unchecked null dominated_by is a fabrication finding under AGENTS rule 5.
joints.breaking_artifact: A frontier row, omitted by the record, that dominates the record on every axis.

joints.joint: J5 controls: the declared null battery and known-false object can detect the artifact the record is exposed to, and a decay parameter is named.
joints.attack_plan: For each record name the artifact it is exposed to (reparametrisation, shape-only solver cost, planted-instance bias, seed dependence) and test whether the declared PGL_2 battery, translation-conjugate null, shape-matched random system, planted instance and known-false object would reproduce the record's predicted signal if the artifact were the whole story. Ask what parameter should destroy the signal and whether the record says what the measurement looks like as it grows. Coordinator's expected break: known-false objects chosen for convenience rather than inconvenience.
joints.breaking_artifact: A control set under which the record's predicted signal and the artifact are indistinguishable, or a missing decay parameter.

joints.joint: J6 recalled citations: every load-bearing recalled reference says what the record relies on.
joints.attack_plan: For each citation with provenance recalled that a claim, heuristic or novelty argument leans on, locate the source (WebSearch and WebFetch), confirm the specific theorem or bound cited, and report the delta; where retrieval fails, record the reference as unlocated rather than as confirmed. Coordinator's expected break: at least one recalled reference on finite-field SMT theories, model counters or theta normal forms is mis-attributed or does not state what is claimed.
joints.breaking_artifact: The located source passage beside the record's paraphrase, with the discrepancy named.

objects: the same curve under a uniformly random PGL_2(F_p) reparametrisation of each coordinate (a representation on which no stage cost may change)
a shape-matched random Boolean or random F_p polynomial system with the same variable blocks and monomial supports (a system on which no elliptic-curve structure can be doing the work)
a prime cyclic group (Z/N, +) given only as a black-box group (an object on which every generic-group bound applies and no non-generic saving exists)
proves_too_much.failure_signature: On the random reparametrisation the record's argument must predict NO change in any stage cost; on the shape-matched random system it must predict NO solver saving attributable to structure; on the black-box prime cyclic group it must predict NO sub-N^(1/2) route. An argument that still yields its claimed saving on any of these objects has proved too much, and the reviewer reports the step at which it survives.
